facts.fact: Algorithm 1 Tree Traversal Algorithm: function TRAVERSETREE(tree, query, k) S_current ← tree.layer[0] for layer in range(tree.num_layers) do top_k ← [] for node in S_current do score ← dot_product(query, node) top_k.append((node, score)) end for S_layer ← sorted(top_k)[:k].nodes S_current ← S_layer end for return S_0 ∪ S_1 ∪ S_2 ∪ … ∪ S_k end function
